subject: Life Skills
title: Sinking Funds
description: A quick win: understand Sinking Funds.

hook.text: Christmas comes every December. Yet every December, millions of people are 'surprised' by the expense.

buildup.text: A sinking fund saves small amounts monthly for predictable expenses: holidays, car insurance, vacations.

discovery.text: If car insurance costs $1,200 annually, save $100 a month. When the bill arrives, the money is already waiting.

twist.text: Without sinking funds, predictable costs feel like emergencies. They raid your emergency fund or hit your credit card.

climax.text: List every large annual or semi-annual expense. Divide each by 12. Set up a monthly auto-transfer for each one.

punchline.text: Predictable expenses are not emergencies. Fund them monthly.

quiz.question: What is a sinking fund?
options: An emergency account for unexpected costs
Monthly saving for a known future expense spread over time
A fund that loses value over time due to inflation
